articles.title: Reports: Reeling Sounders acquiring Dejan Joveljic from SKC
articles.description: The Seattle Sounders are finalizing a deal to acquire forward Dejan Joveljic from Sporting KC, according to multiple reports. Joveljic, 27, will be expected to provide a boost to an anemic Sounders offense that has produced only 22 goals in 20 matches.
